description: Browse Social AI website builder block types with groups, search, pagination, and reference links so users can inspect headers, heroes, product sections, promo/ad blocks, forms, and footers before choosing what to add.

group.description: Optional group/subgroup filter, e.g. Navigation, Hero Sections, Product Sections, Promotions, Forms, Footer.

limit.description: Maximum blocks to return (default 30, max 200). Use 8-12 for a short recommendation list.

q.description: Natural search text, e.g. hero, header, navigation, promo, ad, product, footer, contact, trust, checkout.

name: list_blocks
